page.overview:
Who is Mime Artist?

The Mime Artist is a minor character in A Bug's Life. He is a black and white caterpillar and street mime who is as bothersome, irritating, and obnoxious as any human street performer. He is seen miming in the streets of the insect city.

"A cheerful black and white caterpillar mime tries to interest Flik in his street performance, and even imitates Flik's hurried walk. But Flik wants directions—not entertainment. And he's not going to get directions from this character. Pantomime artists don't talk."

After Flik talks to a homeless cricket, whose wings had been pulled off by a kid, the mime artist starts miming next to Flik, pretending he's touching an imaginary wall. Flik runs off when he sees a fly getting beat up outside of a bar by a bouncer wasp (whom Flik thinks is a tough bug), and the mime artist imitates Flik.
